scenes.text: Can a home be hotter inside than out?
Yes. Thin metal roofs heat fast, small windows let little air through, and the heat stays long after sunset.
In a survey of eight hundred and sixty households in Ahmedabad, people in informal settlements faced temperatures up to seven point six degrees higher.
A cool roof can change the whole night: reflective paint, shade and a cross-breeze, before any machine.
Safe from heat starts with the roof.
